definitions.explanation: The Japanese imperial era name for the reign of Emperor {昭和|しょうわ} (Hirohito), spanning 1926 to 1989. Years are counted from the start, so {昭和|しょうわ}{50年|ねん} is 1975.

examples.japanese: {昭和|しょうわ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧です。
examples.english: I was born in the Showa era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昭和|しょうわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|い}きた→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather lived through the Showa era.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町並|まちな}み→町並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{昭和|しょうわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色濃|いろこ}く⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: This townscape still retains a strong Showa-era atmosphere even today.

notes:
The ⟦{元号|げんごう}→元号：16318_gengou⟧ (Japanese era name) for 1926–1989, the reign of Emperor {昭和|しょうわ}. Years within the era are counted from one, so {昭和|しょうわ}⟦{元年|がんねん}→元年：11658_gannen⟧ is 1926.

USAGE:
Colloquially, {昭和|しょうわ} describes things that feel old-fashioned or nostalgically retro:
- {昭和|しょうわ}⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: has a retro, old-school feel
- {昭和|しょうわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: a nostalgic, bygone atmosphere

RELATED ERAS:
- ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧: Meiji (1868–1912)
- ⟦{平成|へいせい}→平成：11180_heisei⟧: Heisei (1989–2019)
- ⟦{令和|れいわ}→令和：11181_reiwa⟧: Reiwa (2019–present)
